eyebrow: Six types, no more, no less
code:
"a string"      - text, always double-quoted
42               - number (int or float)
true / false     - boolean
null             - explicitly "nothing"
{...}            - object (key/value pairs)
[...]            - array (ordered list)
caption: No dates, no functions, no comments — just these six.
Double-quoted keys, commas between pairs, none after the last.

steps.label: Array [ ]
steps.sub: ordered — look things up by position, e.g. items[0]
